dataset_verification.verdict_reason: The sole Dryad record named in thompson_1917_dataset_audit.json (doi:10.5061/dryad.dn160) is a population-genetics / reproductive-isolation dataset for Atlantic Strongylocentrotus lineages. Its files contain allele frequencies and breeding experiments, not test meridian profiles, axial:equatorial ratios, or any Thompson-style shell geometry. It does NOT match the claim variables. Wikimedia Commons photographs of empty sea-urchin tests (CC BY 2.0 / CC BY-SA) DO match the measurable urchin-test instance: axisymmetric silhouettes suitable for meridian extraction and Preston + Thompson-envelope fitting. No analogue substitution was applied to the Dryad record; it is documented as DATASET_MISMATCH and excluded from fitting.
